title: Cervical Cancer Screening in Madagascar Using Smartphone Photos and Mobile Telemedicine
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether smartphone photos may assist health-care worker (on-site) and to evaluate the diagnostic reliability and accuracy of cervical examination with smartphone photos of VIA (D-VIA), on-site and off-site, compared with conventional VIA, for human papillomavirus (HPV) positive women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 30-49 years
* HPV-positive
* Attending the cervical cancer screening program conducted by the Saint-Damien Health-Care Centre
* Understands study procedures and accepts voluntarily to participate by signing the informed consent form (ICF)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous Hysterectomy
* Conditions that can interfere with visualization of the cervix
* Pregnancy \> 20 weeks
* Not able to comply with protocol study.
